## 2.17 Closed-Loop Action Orchestration

### Control loop

1. Observe
2. Diagnose
3. Model
4. Propose
5. Simulate
6. Validate
7. Approve
8. Execute
9. Verify
10. Monitor
11. Roll back or compensate
12. Learn

### Safety requirements

- idempotent actions;
- action deduplication;
- dry-run mode;
- shadow mode;
- canary execution;
- bounded autonomy;
- human approval tiers;
- circuit breakers;
- rollback and compensation;
- effect monitoring;
- immutable audit logs;
- kill switch.

### Evidence artifacts

- Action orchestration state machine
- Compensation catalogue
- Execution simulator
- Shadow-mode evaluation
- Rollback drill report
